title: sdks: unify auth/retries and streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go + parity fixes + bump v1.36.1
author: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: This PR unifies auth and retry behavior and improves streaming ergonomics across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. It includes parity fixes discovered during cross-SDK tests and bumps the SDK surface version to v1.36.1. Motivation: multiple downstream teams reported inconsistent retry semantics and streaming client ergonomics between SDKs (e.g. different default backoffs, inconsistent token refresh behavior when streaming). These differences make cross-language integrations brittle and complicate server-side routing/fallback logic. What changed: - Auth: centralized token refresh contract and transparent background refresh for long-lived streaming connections. All SDKs now expose a single token provider interface and consistent default TTL+refresh threshold semantics. - Retries: unified retryable error classification and exponential backoff policy with jitter. Client libraries now honor max attempts and provide an onRetry hook for telemetry. - Streaming ergonomics: single-pattern APIs for chunked streaming and cancellation. Client-side helpers for assembling partial events and automatic reconnection when streaming gaps are detected (subject to config). - Parity fixes: matched TS/Go behavior to Python for edge cases (403 vs 401 handling, 429 soft-fail semantics). - Version bump: SDK public package versions set to v1.36.1 and changelogs updated. Notes for reviewers: most behavior is additive and backward-compatible; the default backoff window is conservative to avoid surprising rate increases. Hotfixes: included a small hotfix for Go auth token race that surfaced during testing. Migration notes: - Servers/clients that implement custom retry logic should verify they don't duplicate onRetry hooks to avoid duplicate telemetry. - Token provider adapters will continue to work but should prefer the new TokenProvider interface for streaming workloads. Checklist: - [x] Python: auth + retries + streaming helpers implemented - [x] TypeScript: parity fixes and ergonomics updates - [x] Go: auth race hotfix + API parity - [x] Cross-SDK integration tests added - [x] Changelogs updated - [x] Docs/README snippets updated Links: Linear ENG-4123, ENG-4198; support ticket SUP-2241.

review_comments: Diego Morales: Please confirm that token refresh does not block streaming reads. If it does, we need a non-blocking background refresh to avoid stalling long polls.

Aisha Patel: We implemented background refresh using a dedicated goroutine/thread in each SDK; refresh runs 30s before expiry and does not block read loops. Added unit test to validate non-blocking behavior.
Evelyn Zhang: The exponential backoff default looks aggressive for low-QPS services. Can we expose a config to tune base/backoff ceiling?
Aisha Patel: Exposed RetryConfig with base_delay, max_delay, max_attempts. Default values chosen conservatively; added documentation in migration guide.
Samir Rao: Found flaky test in TS streaming reconnection flow (race between onclose and onmessage). Suggested adding deterministic ordering in stream teardown.
Aisha Patel: Fixed ordering and added a deterministic teardown sequence in streaming helper utilities; re-ran integration tests.
Evelyn Zhang: Approving pending minor comment fix to changelog formatting.
Diego Morales: LGTM after changelog fix. Approving.
release_notes: v1.36.1: Unify auth token refresh and retry behavior across SDKs; improve streaming ergonomics and add parity fixes. See docs/sdks/migration_v1.36.1.md for migration steps.
